title: Yara and the Asset
author: Hazel Thornbury
blurb: Sable Eastwick, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
